questions.prompt: Which period do the figures for 601,620 families describe?
options: The month of June before the reminder.
questions.explanationZh: s3—s4区分6月数据与10月发布的提醒。

questions.prompt: A family has two eligible children. How should their accounts be arranged?
options: One shared account with two separate limits.
A separate account for each of the children.
One parental account and one holiday account.
Two accounts divided by type of childcare.
questions.explanationZh: s8规定按子女分别开户，而不是按家庭或托育类型划分。

questions.prompt: Why does opening an account not finish the ongoing requirements?
options: The family must change childcare providers each term.
The deposits must be spent within each school holiday.
The holder must confirm details every three months.
The yearly limit must be requested from each nursery.
questions.explanationZh: s13说明为了持续获得追加补贴，需要每三个月确认资料。

questions.prompt: How should a parent interpret the reported £93 average?
options: As a description of June payments across those families.
As the monthly amount paid to every eligible child.
As the minimum deposit required to open an account.
As the quarterly maximum for a household account.
questions.explanationZh: s15将93英镑限定为6月该群体平均值；s6的补贴上限是不同概念。
